QuantRule complete command reference
====================================

Data
----

candles <csv-path>

Read a CSV strictly and print the retained candle window as NDJSON.

Options
  none

Output
  NDJSON, one candle per line, oldest first; at most 1000 lines.

Notes
  A malformed row, invalid OHLC, duplicate timestamp, or out-of-order timestamp aborts the command.
  The window is built before writing, so a late error produces no partial NDJSON.

candles-tolerant <csv-path>

Read a CSV, skip row-level failures, and report quality on stderr.

Options
  none

Output
  NDJSON on stdout; one quality summary and one line per skipped row on stderr.

Notes
  A missing file or bad header aborts; row-level failures are skipped and counted.
  A run with skipped rows, including a file where every row is rejected, exits 0.

timeframes <csv-path>

Build M5, M15, and H1 from an M1 CSV and print the four series.

Options
  none

Output
  NDJSON grouped M1, M5, M15, H1; aggregation, partial, and gap records on stderr.

Notes
  M1 is the source; M5, M15, and H1 are derived by the data engine.
  A complete trailing bucket is published; an incomplete bucket is dropped and counted.
  No derived CSV is written.

Model
-----

market-state <csv-path> [--window full|latest]

Print the four-timeframe market state as one JSON object.

Options
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.

Output
  One JSON object with ladder, timeframes, aggregates, and consensus.

Notes
  The model publishes numbers; the shell maps stable codes to labels.
  The four axes are separate; agreement is a count, never an average.
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles; --window latest uses the last 1000 per timeframe.

market-dashboard <csv-path> [--window full|latest] [--json]

Print the four-axis dashboard, one row per timeframe.

Options
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.
  --json                       Print the numeric dashboard state as one JSON object.

Output
  Fixed-width four-track text, or one numeric JSON object with --json.

Notes
  Missing value: an em dash with a reason code; a valid zero prints 0%.
  The view is descriptive; it is not a strategy, forecast, or recommendation.

market-chart <csv-path> --png <path> [--timeframe <tf>] [--candles <n>] [--window full|latest]

Render the last candles and the four axis panels as a deterministic PNG.

Options
  --png <path>                 Required PNG target.
  --timeframe <tf>             Chart timeframe: 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h (default 1m).
  --candles <n>                Last n bars, 1..1000 (default 1000).
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.

Output
  A PNG; prints png=<path> timeframe=<tf> candles=<n> bytes=<n>.

Notes
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles; --window latest charts a larger fetch.
  The four axis panels share the [-1,+1] scale; a missing axis is a gap, never zero.

market-report <csv-path> --data-version <id> [--from <date>] [--to <date>] --out <dir> [--json]

Write the full-period market report and its charts.

Options
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --from <date>                Inclusive UTC start date, YYYY-MM-DD.
  --to <date>                  Inclusive UTC end date, YYYY-MM-DD.
  --out <dir>                  New or empty output directory; required.
  --json                       Print report.json bytes to stdout.

Output
  Four artifacts in order: summary.txt, report.json, price-axes.png, events.png.

Notes
  Input cap: 600000 M1 candles.
  Contains no order, fill, position, trade, equity, or P&L field.
  The output directory must be absent or empty; a failure removes the partial set.

axis <csv-path> <axis> [--window full|latest]

Print one axis per timeframe: direction, momentum, structure, or progression.

Options
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.

Output
  One NDJSON line per timeframe.

Notes
  Each line carries the numeric fields, compact code, readiness and reason codes, labels, and counters.
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles.

events <csv-path> [--window full|latest]

Print every event record in the analyzed window as NDJSON.

Options
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.

Output
  One NDJSON line per event, grouped by timeframe and ordered by availability.

Notes
  Types: level, divergence, and signal.
  Every record carries occurrence and availability; an event never appears before it is knowable.
  Events are evidence; they do not alter an axis value.

legs <csv-path> [--window full|latest]

Print the minor and major leg per timeframe.

Options
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.

Output
  Two NDJSON lines per timeframe, one per pivot scale.

Notes
  A leg's stage may be null while its origin is unconfirmed or its target is unstable.
  A target revision changes the target version without a price movement.

model-series <csv-path> [--timeframe <tf>] [--bars <n>] [--window full|latest]

Print the last complete model bars as NDJSON.

Options
  --timeframe <tf>             Restrict to 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h (default: whole ladder).
  --bars <n>                   Bars per timeframe, 1..1000 (default 1000).
  --window <full|latest>       Input window: full up to 100000 (default) or last 1000.

Output
  NDJSON, one complete model bar per line, oldest first.

Notes
  Each line carries the candle, six readings, the four axes with diagnostics, context, and consensus.
  Events stay a separate command because one bar can carry several events.
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles.

Research
--------

research export <csv-path> <dataset> --data-version <id> [--root <dir>]

Write the research dataset: raw M1, three layers, manifest, dictionary, and codes.

Options
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --root <dir>                 Export root (default: data).

Output
  Writes the raw M1 file and the processed layer files; prints row counts and file count.

Notes
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles; an over-cap input fails rather than truncating.
  The export is deterministic; the manifest records the data version, configuration, row counts, and files.

research summary <csv-path>

Print counts, ranges, ordinal histograms, and axis correlations.

Options
  none

Output
  One line per timeframe and axis, then one line per timeframe and axis pair.

Notes
  Ordinal codes are counted, never averaged; no line combines the axes.
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles.

Strategy
--------

strategy-run <csv-path> --strategy <name> --data-version <id> [--from <date>] [--to <date>] [--json]

Print strategy entries and exits as NDJSON; no fills or P&L.

Options
  --strategy <name>            Strategy name; required (axis-agreement).
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --from <date>                Inclusive UTC start date, YYYY-MM-DD.
  --to <date>                  Inclusive UTC end date, YYYY-MM-DD.
  --json                       Print one provenance envelope instead of bare NDJSON.

Output
  NDJSON entries and exits, or one JSON envelope with --json.

Notes
  Input cap: 600000 M1 candles; reads the strategy timeframe only.
  Stops at the decision: no order, fill, position, equity, trade, or P&L.
  Model Signal events are not strategy entries or exits.

Runs
----

report <engine> --config <run.json> [--out <dir>] [--json]

Write one config-driven report bundle under <out>/<engine>/.

Options
  --config <path>              The run configuration; required.
  --out <dir>                  Output root override (default: the run config).
  --json                       Print report.json bytes to stdout.

Output
  One bundle and its artifact paths, or report.json bytes with --json.

Notes
  Engines: model, strategy, execution, portfolio, or analytical.
  Runs only the engines the bundle needs; a non-empty target is refused and a partial bundle is removed on failure.

backtest --config <run.json> [--out <dir>] [--json]

Run the full pipeline and write all five bundles.

Options
  --config <path>              The run configuration; required.
  --out <dir>                  Output root override (default: the run config).
  --json                       Print a deterministic summary envelope.

Output
  Five bundle paths, or one JSON summary envelope with --json.

Notes
  Loads the candles once, runs the pipeline once, and computes the model once.
  The input cap comes from data.json.max_candles, at most 600000.
  A non-empty output root is refused before any write.

lab summary <lab-dir> --role <role> --data-version <id> --config <run.json> --created-utc <ts> [--operator human|agent] [--notes <path>] [--force]

Write one deterministic summary.txt for a lab result folder.

Options
  --role <role>                researcher, developer, or validator; required.
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --config <path>              The run configuration; required.
  --created-utc <ts>           Explicit UTC time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; required.
  --operator <kind>            human or agent (default human).
  --notes <path>               Include role notes verbatim.
  --force                      Overwrite an existing summary.txt.

Output
  Writes <lab-dir>/summary.txt and prints wrote <path>.

Notes
  Reads the five report bundles and copies published values; it never recomputes the model.
  The data version must match every report.json and provenance.json.
  Never reads the clock; --created-utc is explicit.
  Refuses an existing summary.txt unless --force is given.

Store
-----

store init [--db <path>]

Create or open the SQLite store and apply the schema migrations.

Options
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  Prints store <path> schema=<n>.

Notes
  Reopening an existing store is idempotent; a version 1 database is migrated in place.
  A store whose schema is newer than the binary is rejected; a file that is not a database fails clearly.

store ingest <csv-path> --dataset <name> --data-version <id> [--db <path>]

Ingest one M1 dataset into the SQLite store.

Options
  --dataset <name>             Dataset name; required.
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  Prints ingested <name> bars=<n> timeframes=<n>.

Notes
  Input cap: 100000 M1 candles.
  Writes one dataset, every ladder bar, consensus row, Layer 3 row, pivot, level, event, and retained leg in one transaction.
  A same-name dataset with a different identity is a conflict until it is removed.

store verify <csv-path> --dataset <name> --data-version <id> [--db <path>]

Verify a stored dataset against a fresh build.

Options
  --dataset <name>             Dataset name; required.
  --data-version <id>          Caller-supplied identity; required.
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  Prints verified <name> bars=<n> tables=7, or the first mismatch.

Notes
  Rebuilds the source, opens the store read-only, and compares every table; it never repairs.
  A dataset with layer3_materialized = 0 is incomplete; re-ingest into a fresh database.

store list [--db <path>]

List the stored datasets as CSV.

Options
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  One CSV row per dataset, sorted by name, with identity, counts, and Layer 3 state.

Notes
  Read-only; a missing file is an error and is never created.

store show <dataset> <table> [--timeframe <tf>] [--bar <n>] [--limit <n>] [--db <path>]

Show one stored table as CSV.

Options
  --timeframe <tf>             Timeframe filter: 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h.
  --bar <n>                    Bar-index filter where the table has one.
  --limit <n>                  Maximum rows, 1..1000 (default 100).
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  CSV rows in DDL order and primary-key order.

Notes
  Tables: bar, consensus, layer3, pivot, level, event, or leg.
  event.reference_code = 0 is rendered as NULL.
  Read-only; a missing file is an error and is never created.

store remove <dataset> [--db <path>]

Remove one dataset and its cascading records.

Options
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  Prints removed <name> bars=<n>; the database file remains.

Notes
  Removing a missing dataset is an error.
  Other datasets remain; removing the same name with a different identity is a conflict until removed.

db series <dataset> [--timeframe <tf>] [--limit <n>] [--db <path>]

Read stored candles as NDJSON.

Options
  --timeframe <tf>             Timeframe filter: 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h.
  --limit <n>                  Maximum rows, 1..1000 (default 100).
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  NDJSON with dataset, timeframe_secs, bar_index, ISO open_time, OHLC, and nullable volume; oldest first.

Notes
  Read-only; a missing file is an error and is never created.

db bars <dataset> [--timeframe <tf>] [--bar <n>] [--limit <n>] [--db <path>]

Read the full stored bar table as CSV.

Options
  --timeframe <tf>             Timeframe filter: 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h.
  --bar <n>                    Bar-index filter where the table has one.
  --limit <n>                  Maximum rows, 1..1000 (default 100).
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  CSV with 74 columns.

Notes
  Read-only; a missing file is an error and is never created.

db metrics <dataset> [--timeframe <tf>] [--bar <n>] [--limit <n>] [--db <path>]

Read metrics and resolutions as CSV.

Options
  --timeframe <tf>             Timeframe filter: 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h.
  --bar <n>                    Bar-index filter where the table has one.
  --limit <n>                  Maximum rows, 1..1000 (default 100).
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  CSV with 61 columns: identity, 47 metric columns, and 12 resolution columns.

Notes
  Read-only; a missing file is an error and is never created.

db layer3 <dataset> [--bar <n>] [--limit <n>] [--db <path>]

Read the materialized Layer 3 rows as CSV.

Options
  --bar <n>                    Bar-index filter where the table has one.
  --limit <n>                  Maximum rows, 1..1000 (default 100).
  --db <path>                  Database path (default data/quantrule.db).

Output
  CSV with 285 columns.

Notes
  Read-only; a missing file is an error and is never created.

Sources
-------

fetch <symbol> <start> <end> [--timeframe <tf>] [--csv <path>] [--png <path>] [--candles <n>]

Fetch native BID candles; write a CSV and an optional PNG.

Options
  --timeframe <tf>             Native timeframe: 1m, 5m, 15m, or 1h (default 1m).
  --csv <path>                 CSV target (default: data/<SYMBOL>_<M1|M5|M15|H1>_<start>_<end>.csv).
  --png <path>                 Required PNG target.
  --candles <n>                Last n bars, 1..1000 (default 1000).

Output
  Writes the CSV and PNG; prints symbol, timeframe, dates, row counts, first/last, csv, and png.

Notes
  Reads Dukascopy BID candles; network access is required.
  Dates are inclusive UTC dates in YYYY-MM-DD form; no clock is read.
  Fetched higher intervals are source references; canonical M5/M15/H1 come from timeframes.

Shell
-----

help [<command>|all|glossary|tutorial|roles]

Show the short map, one command contract, or a reference topic.

Options
  none

Output
  The short map with no topic, one command contract, or a reference topic.

Notes
  A topic may be one or two words, such as 'store ingest' or 'lab summary'.
  An unknown topic is an error that points to 'help all'.
  Output is fixed-width plain text; it does not depend on terminal width and has no color.

quit

Exit the shell with status 0.

Options
  none

Output
  No output.

Notes
  Interactive: exits the shell. Non-interactive: exits with status 0.

Reference topics
----------------
  help glossary  Precise terms and definitions.
  help tutorial  The full-pipeline tutorial map.
  help roles     The quant role map and handoffs.
